name: context-mode
description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
one_liner: A plugin that stops AI coding assistants from 'forgetting' mid-task by trimming the noisy output they read and remembering what happened in earlier sessions, so conversations stay cheaper and more coherent.
buyer: A developer or engineering team paying real money in API usage for AI coding tools who is hitting context-limit errors or ballooning token bills on long sessions.
business_use_cases: A dev shop running Claude Code across many client repos installs it to cut their monthly AI API bill by trimming redundant tool output.
A solo developer working on a large legacy codebase uses it so the agent retains project memory across days instead of re-explaining context every session.
A platform offering hosted AI coding agents licenses the underlying technique to reduce their own inference costs at scale.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, team-wide version with usage analytics showing how much token spend was saved, sold as a cost-savings tool.
License the sandboxing/routing engine to AI coding tool vendors who want to cut their own infrastructure costs.

steal_this: This weekend, build a simple 'token savings' report generator on top of it that shows a team lead exactly how many dollars a week they're saving, then pitch it to agencies burning through AI API credits.
